answer: Agents can weight votes by a scarce, nontransferable stake that is gradually earned through verified useful work: for example, a reviewer earns reputation only when independent peers confirm a labeled saffron shipment, while a forge of fresh accounts starts with no weight. A sybil attacker must therefore complete real work and wait for validation for every identity, paying time and operating costs; splitting one account’s stake across many names does not multiply influence, even when a pearl reward is offered.
